title: The booking file has consequences
governingQuestion: What changes when backstage information becomes regulated infrastructure?
rightsBoundary: Protected invitations, films, backstage photography and organizer interfaces remain authorized-embed, link-only, or permission candidates. No reproduction right is inferred from public access.

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: New York makes time itself operational: calendar authority, dispersed venues, capture, broadcast, production labor, orders and memory must coordinate. This chapter follows backstage coordination: The same field that helps a show run—a name, measurement, image, availability or location—can also make labor newly trackable and extractable.
beats.onScreen: Then: New York’s Fashion Workers Act created duties for model management companies, groups and clients, with substantive requirements beginning June 19, 2025.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: New York’s Fashion Workers Act created duties for model management companies, groups and clients, with substantive requirements beginning June 19, 2025. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The Department of Labor now publishes registration, contract, payment, break and workplace-protection guidance that makes parts of the booking relationship auditable.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: The public guidance does not identify the private booking, biometric, casting or identity-data software used at any specific NYFW show.
